entries.quote: We drove meaningful margin expansion this year while sustaining strong top-line growth, and our cash conversion remained healthy.
EBITDA margin expanded again in FY2023 as the business continued to scale efficiently, and free cash flow generation remains a core strength of the model.
Revenue growth accelerated and margins expanded further, reflecting durable operating leverage across the platform.
We delivered another year of double-digit growth and margin expansion, with cash conversion consistent with prior years and no notable change in working-capital dynamics.
